releaseTitle: System Administrator Subpage Polish and QA Seed Host Repair
notes: Reworks System Administrator subpages with larger Concept 1 metric cards, active-tool icons, consistent charcoal/bronze surfaces, and single-column mobile diagnostic layouts instead of cramped two-column tiles.
Restyles legacy admin panels, timelines, forms, and support/backup surfaces so internal tools visually match the main System Administrator page more closely on desktop and mobile.
Fixes /api/full-audit-qa-seed host classification so testing.86chaos.com is allowed while 86chaos.com, app.86chaos.com, staging/custom 86chaos subdomains, and production Firebase remain blocked.
title: 86 Chaos 17.0.35
summary: Rebuilds System Administrator subtabs into the Concept 1 visual language and fixes QA seeding on testing.86chaos.com.
description: Makes every System Administrator internal page substantially more readable on mobile and desktop with the same spacious charcoal/bronze card language as the main admin page, while correcting the full-audit QA seed host guard so testing.86chaos.com is treated as testing without weakening production protection.
